meta.title: Bioinformatics Engineer
meta.tagline: Apply computational methods to biological data.
meta.description: Bioinformatics engineers develop algorithms and tools for analyzing biological data — genomics, proteomics and transcriptomics. They bridge computer science and biology to advance healthcare and research.

details.description: Bioinformatics engineers develop algorithms and tools for analyzing biological data — genomics, proteomics and transcriptomics. They bridge computer science and biology to advance healthcare and research.
details.whyLearn: Apply computational methods to biological data. Bioinformatics engineers develop algorithms and tools for analyzing biological data — genomics, proteomics and transcriptomics. They bridge computer science and biology to advance healthcare and research.
